narrative: This TLS endpoint negotiates RSA-2048 key exchange, which quantum adversaries harvesting today's traffic could later decrypt once cryptographically relevant quantum computers mature.
quantum_impact: RSA key establishment is vulnerable to Shor's algorithm; a sufficiently capable quantum computer breaks the key exchange used to protect this session.
remediation_guidance: Migrate to a hybrid post-quantum key-exchange (e.g. X25519Kyber768) once your TLS stack and client population support it.
